'''Breaker''' was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the conquest on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].

==Armor and equipment==
Breaker wore the normal clone [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]] with gray stripes down the arms. He also wore a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]]. His [[helmet]] was similar to clone trooper helmets except that its front was foldable and the visor was more closely related to [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian helmets]]. He was also equipped with a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], a [[Shoulder-mounted blaster]] on his right shoulder and a [[Wrist blaster/Legends|Wrist blaster]] on his left gauntlet.
